lyrics:
[കന്നഡ വരികൾ] Karirulu karalavagide, Kaarirulu karalavagi hoithu, Katthalagalu matheralu, Kanna muchhalu oorigooru. Bettalaiyitu tari bettalaithu, Keri mathe saagithu, looti jooru.. Kaarirulu karalavagi hoithu. (2 times) Raari rara.... Kathhige chain-u kaige ringu bhooshana. Bhooshana... Kathhige bhayadi arpisuvaru aa kshana.. Aa kshana dharuna... Kaarirulu karalavagi hoithu. (2 ) Kathhalagalu katthi mereyalu, Muthhu katthige yella khali. Alavu yenide ivara katheya mugisalu, Munde katheya heluve nivu keli. Kaarirulu karalavagi hoithu. 
(2)
